notes: Nationwide advisory heat-screening rules. Sports regions cross state lines. Estimated WBGT does not replace an on-site measurement. These do not override state or local requirements.

sports.name: U.S. Soccer / Korey Stringer Institute regional heat guidelines

guidance.green: Normal activity with scheduled water/rest breaks: three 3-minute breaks per hour, or 10 minutes every 40 minutes.
guidance.yellow: Increase breaks: three 4-minute breaks per hour, or 12 minutes every 40 minutes.
guidance.orange: Training up to 2 hours with four 4-minute breaks per hour, or 10 minutes every 30 minutes.
guidance.red: Training up to 1 hour, with four 4-minute breaks; no additional conditioning.
guidance.black: Do not train outdoors; delay until cooler or cancel.

sports.boundary_note: Published chart gaps are conservatively assigned to the more cautious category. Stored minimums are inclusive (>=), including black; the source prints black as greater than its cutoff.
sports.caution_note: Estimates within this many degrees F below the next category's minimum are flagged 'could be higher', because forecast-based WBGT can be off by about a degree. Measured on-site readings are not flagged.
sports.break_note: Turns the guidance above into reminder times: three breaks per hour is one every 20 minutes, four per hour is one every 15 minutes. Black keeps the most frequent schedule for indoor or essential activity only, since outdoor training is not recommended.

workers.name: OSHA table adapted from NIOSH 2016 heat guidance
workers.notes: Screening limits, not automatic mandatory stop-work temperatures. Clothing adjustments, workload, rest schedules, and other factors must be considered.
workers.boundary_note: At or above (>=) a screening limit triggers further assessment. Being below a limit does not guarantee safety.
